Power BI DAX Power Query Dashboard
Lending Club Loan Analysis — Power BI
An end-to-end loan portfolio analysis project built using Power BI, DAX, and Excel to evaluate loan performance, repayment risk, and financial outcomes across a ~10K loan, $163.62M portfolio. The analysis is organized around three business questions: what is the overall health and size of the portfolio, where is repayment risk visible, and how is the portfolio performing financially.
Total Loans 10K ($163.62M)
Current Loan Status 93.75%
Problem Loans 178 loans (1.78%) — $3.21M
Interest Earned $6.00M @ 12.43% avg rate
Remaining Balance $144.59M
Dashboard 1 — Executive Overview
High-level view of portfolio size, loan status, DTI distribution, loan purposes, and loan grades.
Dashboard 2 — Risk Analysis
Evaluates repayment risk across DTI groups, loan purposes, income groups, and loan status.
Dashboard 3 — Financial Performance
Evaluates loan terms, interest-rate distribution, interest earned, and outstanding balances.
The portfolio contains ~10K loans worth $163.62M, with 93.75% currently active
The 10–20% and 20–30% DTI groups together account for ~65% of loans issued
House loans carry the highest problem-loan rate at 8.26%, despite debt consolidation dominating volume
$18.94M in principal and $6.00M in interest have been recovered, with $144.59M remaining outstanding
36-month loans make up 58.83% of total loan amount vs. 41.17% for 60-month loans

Superstore Sales Analysis Dashboard
End-to-end analysis of 4 years of retail data (2014–2017) covering ₹22.97L in sales, 5,009 orders, and 793 customers. Built a fully interactive dashboard with slicers for year and segment filtering, using Power Query for data cleaning, Power Pivot for the data model, and Pivot Tables for dynamic summaries.
Technology led all categories — ₹8.36L in sales and ₹1.45L in profit, the highest margin of any category
West region generated the highest sales (₹7.25L) and profit (₹1.08L) — nearly double the Central region
High & Medium discount orders generated losses of ₹76K and ₹58K — while no-discount orders drove ₹3.21L profit
Q4 was the strongest quarter every year, driven by November and December peak sales

Excel Power Query Power Pivot Dashboard
Employee Attrition Investigation Dashboard
Interactive HR Analytics dashboard built in Microsoft Excel to investigate employee attrition patterns and support data-driven retention decisions.
Domain Human Resources
Tool Microsoft Excel
Dataset IBM HR Analytics
Employees 1,470
Attrition Cases 237
Dashboard Type Investigation Dashboard
Business Problem
The HR department needed to understand why employees were leaving the organization. The objective was to identify high-risk employee groups and uncover patterns related to attrition so HR could make informed retention decisions.
Objective
Build an interactive HR Analytics dashboard to analyze employee attrition across departments, job roles, age groups, income bands, overtime, job satisfaction, and tenure.
Dashboard Features
KPI Cards Interactive Slicers Department Analysis Job Role Analysis Overtime Analysis Job Satisfaction Analysis Income Analysis Tenure Analysis Executive Summary
Research & Development accounted for the highest share of employee attrition (56.1%)
More than half (53.6%) of the employees who left the company had worked overtime
Nearly 47% of attrited employees reported being Dissatisfied or Very Dissatisfied with their job
Nearly half (47.7%) of the employees who left the company belonged to the Below 3K income band
Employees with 0–2 years of tenure accounted for the highest share of employee attrition (43%)

Supply Chain Analytics — Power BI
Built an end-to-end Supply Chain Analytics project using Power BI, DAX, Power Query, and data modeling across 180K+ order-item records. Analyzed operational performance, delivery and logistics, and product profitability through three interactive dashboards. Developed a 3-page interactive Power BI solution covering Supply Chain Operations, Delivery & Logistics, and Product & Profitability. Analyzed ₹36.78M in sales across 65,752 orders, generating ₹3.97M profit at a 10.78% profit margin, evaluating category and country sales performance, shipping modes, delivery status, late deliveries, cancellations, product profitability, discount rates, market-level margins, and loss-making orders.
Total Orders 65,752
Total Sales ₹36.78M
Total Profit ₹3.97M (10.78% margin)
Late Delivery Rate 54.82%
Cancelled / Loss-Making Orders 2,855 cancelled · 24,649 loss-making
Dashboard 1 — Supply Chain Operations
Executive view of sales, profit, orders, quantity, AOV, category/country performance, delivery status, and shipping mode.
Dashboard 2 — Delivery & Logistics Analysis
Analysis of late deliveries, shipping performance, cancellations, regions, order status, and shipping modes.
Dashboard 3 — Product & Profitability Analysis
Analysis of top and bottom products by profit, category margins, market profitability, discount rates, and loss-making orders.
65,752 orders analyzed, generating ₹36.78M in sales and ₹3.97M in profit
54.82% of deliveries arrived late, with First Class shipping showing the highest late-delivery share (37.18%)
2,855 orders were cancelled and 24,649 orders were loss-making
Golf Bags led all categories by profit margin at 17.46%, well above the portfolio average of 10.78%
USCA and Africa led all markets by profit margin, both above 20%
